name: Perch
_about: A character stands at the bottom right of the visible window, her feet at x 480, y 377: halfway between the right end of BMW's speed (x ~355) and the window's right edge (605), with room on both sides. She comes from frames you bake yourself from a Live2D model with tools/live2d_bake and push to the car with scripts/deploy.sh --perch (they never go in this repo: the art belongs to its owner); without them nothing is drawn and the status row says so. One effect layer (shaders.js perch) samples the frame atlas, animated on the renderer's clock: blinks, breathing and swinging twin tails. She stands as on a bus: pulling away leans her right (the happy face when hard), braking leans her left (the braking face), and she sways back past upright when the car settles; speed blows her tails out. Modes: cruise keeps her where she is (BMW's ACC block is at x ~240..345); during route guidance BMW's turn map fills the right of the window and its street-name line crosses the left, so nav and cruiseNav draw nothing and BMW's HUD shows until the route ends.
